title: FoxAE2Upgrade
description: New blocks and items for Applied Energistics 2
body: # FoxAE2Upgrade *** ## This mod is designed for GTNH version of mods! ** FoxAE2Upgrade** is an addon for Applied Energistics 2 that takes your ME system to the next level — _faster, smarter, and way more powerful_ 🚀 **_If vanilla AE2 feels limiting, this mod unlocks its true potential._** ## ⚡ What does this mod add? ⚙️ **Upgrades & improvements** Make your ME network faster, more efficient, and easier to manage. Expand your automation setup with fresh tools and new possibilities. 🧠 **Extended AE2 functionality** Break past the usual limits — automate things that were previously annoying or impossible. 🔧 **New blocks & items \- Duper cobblestone \- Block that automates the press \- Block that automates all crafts related to crystals \- New molecular assemblers \- Block that holds up to 12 craft processors \- New cables \- Advanced ME Drive ** ## 😏 Why should you use it? ✔️ Because default AE2 isn’t enough anymore ✔️ Because you want full control over your system ✔️ Because automation is a lifestyle ✔️ Because _why not?_ ## ⚠️ Requirements * Minecraft **1.7.10 (Forge)** *   Applied-Energistics-2-Unofficial:rv3-beta-992-GTNH. Other versions may work but I don't guarantee it! _**This mod also changes the maximum size of the ME Controler to what you specify in the config. The mod also changes the maximum number of transmitted channels for wireless. **_ ## 🌐 Join the Community 💬 Got questions? Ideas? Found a bug? Join our Discord and be part of the project! 👉 **Discord:** **[\-2 Circle of Hell](https://discord.gg/Td59WbfApr)**
